data.title: GCC Secretary General Meets UN Deputy Special Envoy for Syria
data.content:
Riyadh, November 20, 2026, SPA -- Secretary General of the Gulf Cooperation Council (GCC) Jasem Mohamed Albudaiwi met today with Deputy Special Envoy of the UN Secretary General for Syria Claudio Cordone in Naples, Italy, on the sidelines of the 12th edition of the Rome Mediterranean Dialogues.
    During the meeting, they reviewed several issues of mutual interest and discussed the latest political, security, and humanitarian developments in Syria, as well as ways to support the country at all levels. They also exchanged views on the latest regional and international developments.
    Albudaiwi reaffirmed the GCC states' support for Syria's unity, sovereignty, security, and stability, as well as its brotherly people.
    -- SPA
